shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded patch between two curves on coordinate axes. On the left, use the gray patch enclosed by the blue cubic and orange cube-root curves between x = 0 and x = 1. On the right, use the gray patch underneath the horizontal axis between the blue and orange curves, immediately to the right of the vertical axis.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the bounded area between the two function graphs. Right image: It selects the area between the two traces from the vertical axis to their first intersection on the right.
Rationales: The fill selects the gap between the two plotted functions over a specific horizontal interval. The upper value minus the lower value gives the local height of that region.
